name: What utility connections are required for a tiny home to be legally occupied?
description: Legal occupation of a tiny home, particularly an ADU, requires permanent connections to water, sewer (or septic), and electricity. These must meet local codes.

mainEntity.name: What utility connections are required for a tiny home to be legally occupied?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a tiny home to be legally occupied, especially if it's considered an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), it typically requires permanent connections to essential utilities. This includes potable water, a sanitary sewer system (or approved septic system), and electricity. Some jurisdictions may also require natural gas hookups if available.
